title: Tendering & Procurement Senior Specialist
description: Official Star role in Riyadh focused on tendering operations and procurement support. The role manages the tendering inbox, reviews incoming RFPs and RFQs, tracks opportunities in the RFP tracker, follows up with clients and procurement teams on tender status, monitors procurement portals including Etimad and SAP Ariba, coordinates bid-submission requirements, uploads final submissions, supports vendor registration on client platforms, and keeps internal stakeholders updated. The listing asks for 2-3 years of experience in procurement, tendering, or business development support, plus strong Arabic and English communication.
